blocks.text: O'tmishda boshlangan, hozir ham davom etayotgan holat

O'tmishda boshlangan va **hozir ham davom etayotgan** holat haqida «qancha vaqtdan beri» deganda inglizchada **Present Perfect** ishlatiladi: I**'ve lived** in Tashkent for ten years — O'n yildan beri Toshkentda yashayman. O'zbekchada esa bu yerda **hozirgi zamon** + «**-dan beri**» keladi: «yashayman», «ishlaydi», «taniyman». Shuning uchun o'zbeklar ko'pincha «I live here for ten years» deb aytadi — bu xato. Ingliz tilida «hozir» (I **live**) va «qancha vaqtdan beri» (I**'ve lived**) — boshqa-boshqa zamonlar.

rows: She **has been** in hospital for a week. — U bir haftadan beri kasalxonada.
I**'ve known** Aziz since school. — Azizni maktabdan beri taniyman.
They **live** in London. — Ular Londonda yashaydi.
They**'ve lived** in London for two years. — Ular ikki yildan beri Londonda yashaydi.
It**'s been raining** all day. — Kun bo'yi yomg'ir yog'yapti.

blocks.text: Nega aynan Present Perfect? Bu zamon ikki vaqtni bog'laydi: **have / has** — hozirgi zamon (holat hozir ham bor), **V3** esa o'tmishga ishora qiladi (holat o'shanda boshlangan). Ya'ni bitta shakl «o'tmishdan → hozirgacha» degan butun chiziqni ko'rsatadi. Present Simple esa faqat «hozir» haqida.

«Qancha vaqtdan beri?», «Qachondan beri?» — **How long have / has** + ega + V3? How long **have** you **lived** here? How long **has** she **been** a teacher? Javobda ko'pincha **for** (muddat: for ten years) yoki **since** (boshlanish nuqtasi: since 2015) keladi. «How long do you live here?» yoki «How long are you here?» — xato savollar.

Harakat (jarayon) uzoq davom etayotgan bo'lsa — **have / has been + -ing**: I**'ve been waiting** for an hour — Bir soatdan beri kutyapman. Bu shakl **Present Perfect Continuous** (hozirgi tugallangan davomli zamon) deyiladi; hozircha uni asosan «qancha vaqtdan beri» ma'nosida o'rganamiz. O'zbekchada yana hozirgi zamon: «kutyapman», «o'rganyapti», «yog'yapti» + «-dan beri».

rows: I**'ve been working** / we **have been working**
she**'s been working** / it **has been raining**

items.text: I**'ve been waiting** for an hour.

blocks.text: live, work, study, teach kabi fe'llar bilan ikkalasi ham mumkin, ma'no deyarli bir xil: I**'ve lived** / I**'ve been living** here for five years. Faol jarayon (wait, learn, rain, do, play) bilan ko'pincha `-ing` shakli tanlanadi. Lekin **holat fe'llari** — know, have (egalik), be, like, love, want, believe — Continuous shaklini olmaydi (8-dars), ular bilan faqat **have + V3**.

rows: I've been knowing her for years.
We've been having this car since 2018.
She's been being ill all week.
He**'s wanted** a dog for a long time.
He's been wanting a dog for a long time.

items.text: I**'ve known** her for ten years.

blocks.text: **for** + muddat: for two hours, for ten years, for a long time. **since** + boshlanish nuqtasi: since 8 o'clock, since Monday, since 2015, since I was a child. O'zbekchada ikkalasi ham «**-dan beri**»: «ikki soat**dan beri**» (for), «soat sakkiz**dan beri**» (since). Qaysi birini tanlash — keyingi, 19-darsda batafsil.

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «I live here for five years.» → I**'ve lived** here for five years.; «I am waiting for an hour.» → I**'ve been waiting** for an hour.; «How long do you live here?» → How long **have** you **lived** here?; «I've been knowing him for years.» → I**'ve known** him for years.; «She is married since 2010.» → She**'s been married** since 2010.; «How long are you learning English?» → How long **have** you **been learning** English?

O'zbekchada «**-dan beri**» + hozirgi zamon eshitsangiz, inglizchada Present Perfect kerak: «...-dan beri yashayman» → I**'ve lived** ...; «...-dan beri kutyapman» → I**'ve been waiting** ...; «...-dan beri taniyman» → I**'ve known** ...
for, since va ago farqi — 19-dars; from ... to, until — 104-dars. **How long does it take ...?** («... qancha vaqt oladi?») — boshqa savol, 48-dars.

rows: I**'ve lived** in Tashkent for 10 years.
I**'ve been learning** English since May.

examples.title: **is** ↔ **has been**: now and how long
examples.description: Hozirgi holat — Present (is, lives); qancha vaqtdan beri — Present Perfect (has been, has lived). O'zbekchada ikkalasi ham hozirgi zamon: «kasalxonada» — «dushanbadan beri kasalxonada».

sentences.text: Grandad is in hospital. He**'s been** there since Monday.
sentences.translation: Bobom kasalxonada. U dushanbadan beri **o'sha yerda yotibdi**.

sentences.text: Madina is a teacher. She**'s been** a teacher for twelve years.
sentences.translation: Madina o'qituvchi. U **o'n ikki yildan beri o'qituvchi**.

sentences.text: Tom and Sarah are married. They**'ve been** married since 2010.
sentences.translation: Tom bilan Sara er-xotin. Ular **2010-yildan beri birga**.

sentences.text: It's very hot today. It**'s been** hot all week.
sentences.translation: Bugun juda issiq. **Butun hafta shunday issiq**.

sentences.text: I'm tired. I**'ve been** awake since five o'clock.
sentences.translation: Charchadim. **Soat beshdan beri uyg'oqman**.

sentences.text: Aziz is in London. He**'s been** there for three months.
sentences.translation: Aziz Londonda. U **uch oydan beri o'sha yerda**.

sentences.text: The shop is closed. It**'s been** closed for a week.
sentences.translation: Do'kon yopiq. **Bir haftadan beri yopiq**.

sentences.text: My brother lives in Bukhara, and he**'s lived** there all his life.
sentences.translation: Akam Buxoroda yashaydi — butun umri **o'sha yerda yashagan**.

sentences.text: Bekzod works for a bank. He**'s worked** there since 2019.
sentences.translation: Bekzod bankda ishlaydi. U **2019-yildan beri** o'sha yerda **ishlaydi**.

sentences.text: Emma and I are good friends. We**'ve been** friends since primary school.
sentences.translation: Emma ikkalamiz yaqin do'stmiz. **Boshlang'ich maktabdan beri do'stmiz**.

examples.title: How long **have** you ...? — For ... / Since ...
examples.description: Savol: How long **have / has** + ega + V3? O'zbekchada: «Qachondan beri ...?», «Qancha vaqtdan beri ...?». Javob — for yoki since bilan.

sentences.text: How long **have** you **lived** in Tashkent? — Since 2015.
sentences.translation: Toshkentda **qachondan beri yashaysiz**? — 2015-yildan beri.

sentences.text: How long **has** Tom **had** his dog? — For about three years.
sentences.translation: Tomning iti **qachondan beri bor**? — Taxminan uch yildan beri.

sentences.text: And how long **have** your parents **been** married?
sentences.translation: Ota-onangiz **turmush qurganiga necha yil bo'ldi**?

sentences.text: So, Dilnoza, how long **have** you **worked** at the hospital?
sentences.translation: Xo'sh, Dilnoza, kasalxonada **qancha vaqtdan beri ishlaysiz**?

sentences.text: Excuse me, how long **has** this café **been** open?
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, bu kafe **qachondan beri ishlaydi**?

sentences.text: Aziz, how long **have** you **known** Madina? — Since we were kids.
sentences.translation: Aziz, Madinani **qachondan beri taniysan**? — Bolaligimizdan beri.

sentences.text: Tell me, how long **has** your sister **been** in Manchester? — Only a few weeks.
sentences.translation: Ayting-chi, singlingiz **qachondan beri Manchesterda**? — Bir necha hafta bo'ldi, xolos.

sentences.text: Mr Brown, how long **have** you **taught** English here? — For thirty years!
sentences.translation: Janob Braun, bu yerda **qachondan beri ingliz tilidan dars berasiz**? — O'ttiz yildan beri!

sentences.text: Your English is very good! How long **have** you **studied** it?
sentences.translation: Ingliz tilingiz juda yaxshi! Uni **qancha vaqtdan beri o'rganasiz**?

sentences.text: Bekzod has a new car. — Really? How long **has** he **had** it?
sentences.translation: Bekzodning yangi mashinasi bor. — Rostdanmi? Uni **qachondan beri minib yuribdi**?

examples.title: I**'ve lived** ... for / since ...
examples.description: Hozirgacha davom etayotgan holat: have / has + V3 + for (muddat) yoki since (boshlanish nuqtasi). Inkor ham bo'ladi: hasn't spoken since ...

sentences.text: My grandparents **have lived** in the same house for fifty years.
sentences.translation: Bobom va buvim **ellik yildan beri bitta uyda yashaydi**.

sentences.text: Sarah **has worked** as a nurse since she left school.
sentences.translation: Sara maktabni bitirgandan beri **hamshira bo'lib ishlaydi**.

sentences.text: I**'ve wanted** a dog since I was a child.
sentences.translation: Bolaligimdan beri **itim bo'lishini orzu qilaman**.

sentences.text: We**'ve had** this sofa for ages — it's time for a new one.
sentences.translation: Bu divan bizda **anchadan beri bor** — yangisini olish vaqti keldi.

sentences.text: Tom **has played** in the school orchestra for two years.
sentences.translation: Tom **ikki yildan beri** maktab orkestrida **chaladi**.

sentences.text: Madina **has taught** at this university since 2012.
sentences.translation: Madina **2012-yildan beri** shu universitetda **dars beradi**.

sentences.text: The museum **has been** closed for repairs since March.
sentences.translation: Muzey ta'mirlash uchun **martdan beri yopiq**.

sentences.text: My neighbour **hasn't spoken** to me since our argument.
sentences.translation: Janjallashganimizdan beri qo'shnim men bilan **gaplashmaydi**.

sentences.text: Aziz **has supported** the same football team all his life.
sentences.translation: Aziz **butun umri bitta futbol jamoasiga muxlislik qiladi**.

sentences.text: This old bridge **has stood** here for more than two hundred years.
sentences.translation: Bu eski ko'prik **ikki yuz yildan ortiq vaqtdan beri** shu yerda **turibdi**.

examples.title: **have been** + -ing: I**'ve been waiting** for an hour
examples.description: Uzoq davom etayotgan jarayon: have / has been + `-ing`. O'zbekchada: «qirq daqiqadan beri kutyapman», «ertalabdan beri yog'yapti».

sentences.text: I**'ve been waiting** for the bus for forty minutes!
sentences.translation: **Qirq daqiqadan beri** avtobus **kutyapman**!

sentences.text: It**'s been raining** since early morning.
sentences.translation: Erta tongdan beri **yomg'ir yog'yapti**.

sentences.text: Madina **has been learning** English for two years.
sentences.translation: Madina **ikki yildan beri** ingliz tilini **o'rganyapti**.

sentences.text: We**'ve been driving** for six hours, so let's stop for a rest.
sentences.translation: **Olti soatdan beri mashina haydayapmiz** — keling, dam olish uchun to'xtaylik.

sentences.text: The baby **has been crying** all night, and we're exhausted.
sentences.translation: Chaqaloq **tun bo'yi yig'lab chiqdi**, biz holdan toydik.

sentences.text: Bekzod **has been working** on this project since January.
sentences.translation: Bekzod **yanvardan beri** shu loyiha ustida **ishlayapti**.

sentences.text: Sorry I'm late! **Have** you **been waiting** long?
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, kechikdim! **Ko'pdan beri kutyapsizmi**?

sentences.text: My neighbours **have been building** their house for three years!
sentences.translation: Qo'shnilarim **uch yildan beri uy qurishyapti**!

sentences.text: Tom looks tired because he**'s been studying** all day.
sentences.translation: Tom charchagan ko'rinadi, chunki u **kun bo'yi dars tayyorladi**.

sentences.text: Dilnoza and Emma **have been chatting** on the phone for over an hour.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza bilan Emma **bir soatdan ko'proq vaqtdan beri** telefonda **gaplashishyapti**.

examples.title: How long **have** you **been** ...**ing**?
examples.description: Jarayon haqida savol: How long have / has + ega + been + `-ing`? «Qachondan beri ...-yapsiz?» Have you been ...ing? — «...-yapsizmi?», «...-dingmi?»

sentences.text: How long **have** you **been learning** English at this school?
sentences.translation: Bu maktabda ingliz tilini **qancha vaqtdan beri o'rganyapsiz**?

sentences.text: How long **has** it **been snowing**? — Since lunchtime.
sentences.translation: **Qachondan beri qor yog'yapti**? — Tushlikdan beri.

sentences.text: Aziz, how long **have** you **been sitting** here? — About twenty minutes.
sentences.translation: Aziz, bu yerda **qachondan beri o'tiribsan**? — Yigirma daqiqacha.

sentences.text: So how long **have** they **been building** that new bridge?
sentences.translation: Xo'sh, o'sha yangi ko'prikni **qachondan beri qurishyapti**?

sentences.text: Emma, how long **has** your son **been playing** the piano?
sentences.translation: Emma, o'g'lingiz **qachondan beri pianino chaladi**?

sentences.text: Excuse me, **have** you **been waiting** long? — Yes, for ages!
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, **ko'pdan beri kutyapsizmi**? — Ha, anchadan beri!

sentences.text: And how long **has** Bekzod **been working** as a taxi driver?
sentences.translation: Bekzod **qachondan beri taksi haydovchisi bo'lib ishlaydi**?

sentences.text: **Have** you **been running**? You're all red!
sentences.translation: **Yugurib keldingmi**? Qip-qizarib ketibsan!

sentences.text: What **have** you **been doing** all morning? The kitchen is a mess!
sentences.translation: Ertalab bo'yi **nima qilding**? Oshxona ostin-ustin!

sentences.text: Tell me honestly, how long **have** you **been feeling** like this?
sentences.translation: Rostini ayting, o'zingizni **qachondan beri shunday his qilyapsiz**?

examples.title: know, have, be: I**'ve known** her for years
examples.description: Holat fe'llari (know, have — egalik, be, want, love, own) Continuous olmaydi: I've known ... («I've been knowing» emas).

sentences.text: I**'ve known** Dilnoza since we were at school together.
sentences.translation: Dilnozani **maktabdan beri taniyman**.

sentences.text: My parents **have had** the same car for fifteen years.
sentences.translation: Ota-onamda **o'n besh yildan beri** bitta mashina **bor**.

sentences.text: Emma **has been** ill since Friday, so she isn't at work.
sentences.translation: Emma **jumadan beri kasal**, shuning uchun ishda emas.

sentences.text: We**'ve known** about the problem for a long time.
sentences.translation: Muammo haqida **anchadan beri bilamiz**.

sentences.text: Tom **has wanted** to be a pilot since he was six.
sentences.translation: Tom **olti yoshidan beri uchuvchi bo'lishni xohlaydi**.

sentences.text: How long **have** you **had** that cough? — For about a week.
sentences.translation: **Qachondan beri yo'talyapsiz**? — Bir haftacha bo'ldi.

sentences.text: Aziz and I **have been** best friends for twenty years.
sentences.translation: Aziz ikkalamiz **yigirma yildan beri** eng yaqin **do'stmiz**.

sentences.text: My little sister **has loved** horses since she first saw one.
sentences.translation: Singlim otni ilk bor ko'rganidan beri **otlarni yaxshi ko'radi**.

sentences.text: Mr and Mrs Brown **have owned** this shop since 1990.
sentences.translation: Janob va xonim Braunlar **1990-yildan beri** bu do'konning **egasi**.

sentences.text: Bekzod **hasn't had** a day off since the start of the month.
sentences.translation: Oy boshidan beri Bekzodning **birorta ham dam olish kuni bo'lmadi**.

examples.title: I **live** here / I**'ve lived** here for ...
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: hozirgi holat — Present Simple yoki Continuous; «qancha vaqtdan beri» — Present Perfect. O'zbekchada ikkalasi ham hozirgi zamon.

sentences.text: I **work** in a hotel. I**'ve worked** there for six months.
sentences.translation: Mehmonxonada **ishlayman**. **Olti oydan beri** o'sha yerda **ishlayman**.

sentences.text: Dilnoza **plays** the dutar, and she**'s been playing** it since she was nine.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza **dutor chaladi**, to'qqiz yoshidan beri **chalib keladi**.

sentences.text: Our flat **is** quite small, but we**'ve lived** in it for ten happy years.
sentences.translation: Kvartiramiz **ancha kichik**, lekin unda **o'n yildan beri baxtli yashaymiz**.

sentences.text: Do you **know** James? — Yes, I**'ve known** him for years.
sentences.translation: Jeymsni **taniysizmi**? — Ha, uni **ko'p yillardan beri taniyman**.

sentences.text: Is Emma still in Paris? — Yes, she**'s been** there since Christmas.
sentences.translation: Emma hali ham Parijdami? — Ha, **Rojdestvodan beri o'sha yerda**.

sentences.text: Madina **is learning** to drive. She**'s been learning** for three weeks.
sentences.translation: Madina **mashina haydashni o'rganyapti**. **Uch haftadan beri o'rganyapti**.

sentences.text: It**'s raining** again! It**'s been raining** on and off all week.
sentences.translation: Yana **yomg'ir yog'yapti**! **Butun hafta** goh yog'ib, goh tinib **turibdi**.

sentences.text: My grandmother **has** a garden, and she**'s grown** her own vegetables for decades.
sentences.translation: Buvimning **bog'i bor**, u **o'n yillardan beri** sabzavotlarini o'zi **yetishtiradi**.

sentences.text: We **are waiting** for the results. We**'ve been waiting** since nine o'clock!
sentences.translation: Biz natijalarni **kutyapmiz**. **Soat to'qqizdan beri kutyapmiz**!

sentences.text: How long **have** you **been** here? — Not long. I**'ve** only **been** here for five minutes.
sentences.translation: Bu yerda **qachondan beri turibsiz**? — Uncha emas. **Atigi besh daqiqadan beri shu yerdaman**.

examples.title: Dialogue: How long have you been learning English?
examples.description: Suhbatda How long ...?, for, since, have + V3 va have been + `-ing` birga.

sentences.text: — Your English is excellent, Aziz! How long **have** you **been learning** it?
sentences.translation: — Aziz, ingliz tilingiz a'lo darajada! Uni **qancha vaqtdan beri o'rganyapsiz**?

sentences.text: — Thanks! I**'ve been studying** it for about four years.
sentences.translation: — Rahmat! **Taxminan to'rt yildan beri o'rganyapman**.

sentences.text: — Only four years? **Have** you **had** a private teacher all that time?
sentences.translation: — Atigi to'rt yilmi? Shu vaqt davomida **xususiy o'qituvchingiz bo'lganmi**?

sentences.text: — Yes, I**'ve had** the same teacher since my first lesson. She's from Oxford.
sentences.translation: — Ha, birinchi darsimdan beri **o'sha bitta o'qituvchidan o'qiyman**. U Oksforddan.

sentences.text: — And how long **have** you **lived** in London?
sentences.translation: — Londonda-chi, **qachondan beri yashaysiz**?

sentences.text: — Not long. I**'ve been** here since September.
sentences.translation: — Uncha emas. **Sentyabrdan beri shu yerdaman**.

sentences.text: — Great! And **have** you **found** a job here?
sentences.translation: — Zo'r! Bu yerda **ish topdingizmi**?

sentences.text: — Yes, I**'ve been working** in a hotel for two months.
sentences.translation: — Ha, **ikki oydan beri mehmonxonada ishlayapman**.

sentences.text: — Really? Which one? I**'ve known** most of the hotel managers here for years.
sentences.translation: — Rostdanmi? Qaysi birida? Bu yerdagi mehmonxona boshqaruvchilarining ko'pini **yillardan beri taniyman**.

sentences.text: — The Park Hotel. My boss **has worked** there for twenty years!
sentences.translation: — «Park Hotel»da. Boshlig'im u yerda **yigirma yildan beri ishlaydi**!
